banner: Made-up data room for testing agents. Every company, person and figure here is fictional.

entries.question: Why do management and audited FY2026 revenue differ?
entries.answer: The installation cut-off adjustment is £290k. See 2.6 for the full reconciliation.

entries.question: Has Wendmoor renewed?
entries.answer: Renewal discussions are continuing for the term ending 31 March 2027. No renewal has been signed.

entries.question: Is there a break in the Nottingham lease?
entries.answer: The tenant break is 30 September 2028 with six months’ notice. No notice has been served.

entries.question: Has Ardnacree issued proceedings?
entries.answer: No proceedings have been issued. The company disputes liability and is reviewing technical evidence.

entries.question: Does the census include Kilcarrow fixed-term staff?
entries.answer: Version 2 includes employed fixed-term staff within Kilcarrow. Agency workers are excluded.

entries.question: Why is Dunstreath absent from the top-customer schedule?
entries.answer: Dunstreath Retail Group plc left for a national facilities-management provider. The contract ended on 31 March 2026; FY2026 revenue was £3,420k on the management accounts basis. No other customer that has stopped trading with the group since 1 April 2025 had FY2026 revenue above £250k, counting all group companies, contracts and project work.

entries.question: Why does the certificate show 3.25:1 when 2.7 says 3.00:1?
entries.answer: The executed amendment letter of 12 August 2026 (2.11) set the maximum at 3.25:1 for test dates from 30 September 2026 to 31 March 2027, returning to 3.00:1 from 30 June 2027. Document 2.7 predates it and will be revised.

entries.question: When is the monitoring platform migration planned?
entries.answer: January 2027, following dual running and acceptance tests. The timetable remains subject to operational sign-off.

entries.question: Please provide the Kilcarrow SPA and deferred and contingent consideration outstanding.
entries.answer: The SPA will be made available and the contingent consideration redaction in 2.2 lifted in a later phase, once the Kilcarrow vendors’ consent to disclosure is in place.

entries.question: Is the FY2027 budget board-approved?
entries.answer: Yes, the board approved it on 26 March 2026; see the minutes extract at 1.3.

entries.question: Please provide the detailed engineering capacity plan for FY2027.
Is census v2 complete?
entries.answer: Census v1 left out Kilcarrow. Version 2 of 19 October 2026 is complete. Please use v2.
